name: proof.storageFieldIncrement.overflow-step-dropped.1
diff:
--- a/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
+++ b/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
@@ -587,3 +587,3 @@
   | storageFieldIncrement :
-      dl{ ⟨[ sp.fld⊕⊕; ]⟩ ⇝ { storage := save(storage, sp.fld, sp.fld ± 1) } ⟨[ ]⟩ }
+      dl{ ⟨[ sp.fld⊕⊕; ]⟩ ⇝ { storage := save(storage, sp.fld, sp.fld) } ⟨[ ]⟩ }
   | storageIndexIncrement :

diagnostics.message:
Solidity.Taclet.storageFieldIncrement: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.incDec op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.field (SPath.alias i✝) fld✝ hfld✝))
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  Premise.update
    (Upd.nil.snoc
      (UpdElem.storage
        (Tms.STerm.save Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝)
          (Tms.SValT.val (Tms.Term.find Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝))))))

case alias
C✝ : Contract
k✝ : Nat
m✝ : Modality
Γ✝ : Ctx
p✝ : PrimTy
op✝ : IncDec
hp✝ : p✝.isNumeric = true
x✝ fld✝ : Name
hfld✝ : C✝.fieldType x✝ fld✝ = some (Ty.prim p✝)
i✝ : Idx Γ✝ (LTy.alias (RefTy.struct x✝))
⊢ Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.incDec op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.field (SPath.alias i✝) fld✝ hfld✝)) =
    Premise.update
      (Upd.nil.snoc
        (UpdElem.storage
          (Tms.STerm.save Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝)
            (Tms.SValT.val (Tms.Term.find Tms.STerm.storage (Tms.PTerm.field (SPath.alias i✝).lower fld✝ hfld✝))))))
